verdict.rationale: A probe records an official Atlassian MCP server at github.com/atlassian/atlassian-mcp-server, so the vendor does ship a first-party MCP server an agent could connect to. However, the evidence is a single probe line and does not document which Bitbucket operations it exposes, how to set it up, or how it authenticates. missing for 10: confirmation of Bitbucket-specific tool coverage in the MCP server, setup/auth documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
